releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.10 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
* Strict Package Quarantine: 100% isolation from phone launcher, app menu, settings, and other apps - never touches phone menus or opens Play Store.
* Foreground Ad Prioritization: Video ads and banners take precedence over background episode list unlock triggers.
* 0s Timer & Pill Fix: 'Reward in 0s' and 'Reward granted' pill buttons properly scored and dismissed.
* Expanded Touch Boundaries: Buttons up to 450px supported for modern high-DPI displays.
* Video Ad Patience Window: Extended trapped timeout to ~21.6s to allow full video playback.
